method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record, its recorded City Council agenda history, and each official attachment. Downloaded source originals were hashed and extracted before lineage decisions.

matter.title: Capital Improvements Plan Community Equity Criterion

attachments.title: R-20-85 original resolution
attachments.reason: The original proposed a racial-equity criterion for the 2021 and subsequent bond programs; the enacted floor substitute changed the operative criterion and program timing.

attachments.title: R-20-85 approved floor substitute
attachments.reason: The approved floor substitute is a pre-enactment version; the archived enacted City resolution is the authoritative final text.

attachments.title: R-20-85 enacted resolution
attachments.reason: Exact SHA-256 match to the already validated and publicly byte-identical enacted-resolution archive.

result: No new archival object or site placement is warranted. The matter’s complete attachment lineage is represented by the existing enacted canonical record and two documented superseded drafts.
